name: KeyController
author: KeyController contributors
description: Let AI agents, apps and deployment scripts ask for SSH access, then unlock with your fingerprint or key passphrase. Manage existing keys from the Omarchy bar with live search, per-key countdowns, one-click revocation and optional revoke-before-sleep. Works with the standard OpenSSH agent for SSH and Git, and follows your Omarchy theme.

barWidget.description: SSH keys, fingerprint unlock and access timers
